selectedTreatment.retention: Selected entry/workspace and all distinct approved workflow/state specimens retained with source and reproducible render evidence. Unused alternatives and superseded entry screenshots removed.

sourceIdeaApproval.question: Does this source Idea layout and interpretation-status presentation look right?
sourceIdeaApproval.approvalScope: Source Idea layout and interpretation-status presentation shown: retained original separate from AI interpretation, with the interpretation in Surrounding context. The shown ready and failed desktop specimens were accepted.

recoveryApproval.question: Do these upload and retry recovery screens look right?
recoveryApproval.approvalScope: The shown desktop upload and retry recovery presentations, with these explained behaviors: checking an upload does not reupload it; retry Check is separate from an explicit same-request resend; processing requests are never sent automatically.

existingViewsApproval.question: Does this treatment of imported files across Explore, Evolve, Ask, and Export look right?
existingViewsApproval.approvalScope: The shown desktop media treatment across Explore, Evolve, Ask and Export: separate searchable source and AI interpretation, media-kind filter, file descriptor and clarification in Evolve, descriptor/clarification preview in Ask, and descriptor-based exports rather than binary contents. Search and Agentic Export do not gain access to original file contents.

rejectedInspectionApproval.question: Does this presentation of rejected originals and interpretations look right?
rejectedInspectionApproval.approvalScope: The shown desktop presentation of rejected sources and interpretations: deliberate user inspection only; original remains retained and downloadable; no new AI work for rejected material; rejected content is excluded from AI access.
rejectedInspectionApproval.finalCopyClarification: Applied: 'Rejected content is unavailable to AI.' Mixed inspection banners refer specifically to rejected content, not all inspected content. Rejection does not delete the original file.

edgeCasesApproval.question: Does this presentation of upload, processing, and download edge cases look right?
edgeCasesApproval.approvalScope: The shown desktop upload/admission and interpretation/status edge-case comparison sheets, and original-download failure presentation. The sheets show alternative states, not simultaneous UI. Confirmed saved interpretations survive later processing or original-download failure.

responsiveApproval.question: Does this narrow-screen treatment look right?
responsiveApproval.additionalAccess: The user was also given the review gallery link containing the other phone variants.
responsiveApproval.approvalScope: The responsive treatment represented by these four specimens: stacked columns, naturally wrapping actions and Send beside the contribution field. This approves the shared narrow-screen approach, not a claim that every linked phone specimen was individually examined.

content: All draft text, filename, byte size, clarification and run identity are illustrative; no personal records or files were read.
stateBoundary: The queued specimen is a fresh, confirmed admission with its original known run ID and no confirmed interpretation. It makes no claim about absent agent configuration, current-run discovery from source identity or retry eligibility.
interactionBoundary: A small design simulation switches specimens. No picker, upload, source reading, Markdown workflow, Check, Stop, persistence or daemon boundary is implemented. Existing Markdown behavior remains unchanged. Capture chooser toggling retains the visible draft; cross-view draft lifetime is not verified by this study.
responsiveIntent: 1440 by 900 desktop and 390 by 844 narrow viewports; full-page captures. Existing readable type, 44px targets, stacked narrow navigation and full-width narrow primary actions. B columns stack in source-then-clarification order. No motion added.
